activity.notes: Stalin became General Secretary of the Communist Party's Central Committee in April 1922. The formal General Secretary designation was no longer assigned after the Nineteenth Party Congress in October 1952, although Stalin remained the dominant Soviet leader until his death. ATLAS therefore records the formal party office separately from his de facto rule.

sources.title: Foreign Relations of the United States, 1981–1988, Volume X — Persons
sources.citation_text: The U.S. Department of State historical series lists Joseph Stalin as General Secretary of the Communist Party central committee from April 1922 until October 1952.
